newsitem.title: INDIA: India Mahindra up 4 pct before results.
newsitem.headline: India Mahindra up 4 pct before results.

text.p: Shares of Indian tractor and utility vehicle maker Mahindra & Mahindra rose 13.25 rupees, or nearly four percent, to 357.0 on Tuesday ahead of its annual results, traders said.
Over 119,750 shares of Mahindra had traded at the Bombay Stock Exchange as the close approached, traders said.
The firm is due to announce its results at about 1600 hours (1030 GMT).

Ananlysts said they expected strong growth in rural disposable incomes to drive Mahindra's net 21 percent higher to an average 2.03 billion rupees, (US$56.7 million) in 1996/97 (April-March), from 1.68 billion the previous year.
Mahindra is among the country's top 20 private firms.
